observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Hisense microwave oven.
The box identifies the model as H20MOWS14.
The box lists features: 20L capacity, 700W power, and mechanical controls.
The actual microwave unit is not visible in the photo.
The box is stacked on another Hisense branded box.

claims.evidence: Only the box is shown; the item itself and its seals are not visible.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, older, or damaged model.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual microwave unit outside of the box.

risks.risk: The item may be used or have internal damage/rust.
risks.proof: Photos of the interior cavity and the door seals.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used in poor condition.

risks.risk: The unit may have electrical faults or fail to heat.
risks.proof: A video of the unit powered on and heating a cup of water.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual microwave unit outside of the box.
Photos of the interior cavity and the specification sticker on the back of the unit.
A short video showing the unit plugged in and heating water.
response.reason: Only the packaging is shown. In a remote second-hand transaction, the item itself must be visible to verify its existence and condition before a price can be assigned.
